items.definition:
the branch of science concerned with the substances of which matter is composed
I enjoy studying chemistry.

a deduction from the usual cost
They offered a 10% discount.

a person or thing that is excluded from a general statement or rule
There is an exception to every rule.

what is put in, taken in, or operated on by any process or system
We need more input from the team.

a state of great comfort or elegance, especially when involving great expense
They live a life of luxury.

the words of a song
I love the lyric of this song.

result
What was the outcome of the meeting?

survey
The latest poll shows a shift in public opinion.

an area or period
We went for a long stretch of road.

state of being away
Her absence was noted by the teacher.

something given
Her contribution to the project was significant.

lack of difficulty
He passed the exam with ease.

being widely known
She achieved international fame as a singer.

an overflow of water
The heavy rain caused a flood in the town.

a penalty for wrongdoing
The punishment for the crime was severe.

a movement back and forth
The child loved playing on the swing in the park.

a level area for public events
The concert will be held in the main arena.

a vertical division of a page or text
Read the first column of the newspaper.

a place where roads or railway lines cross
Be careful when you approach the railway crossing.

the cost incurred in doing something
Travel expenses can add up quickly.

advice or information aimed at resolving a problem or difficulty
We sought guidance from an expert.

a plan or aim
His intention was to finish the project by Friday.

the action of taking part in something
Student participation is encouraged in class discussions.

a person authorized to perform sacred rites of a religion
The priest gave a sermon during the service.

a thing given in recognition of one's service, effort, or achievement
Hard work often brings its own reward.

a device or enclosure designed to catch and retain animals
The hunter set a trap for the rabbit.

wild animals collectively; the native fauna of a region
The park is home to diverse wildlife.

a sudden loud noise
We heard a loud bang from the kitchen.

a statement that something is unsatisfactory or unacceptable
She filed a complaint about the poor service.

the ability to do something that frightens one
It takes courage to speak in front of a large audience.

a remedy for a disease or illness
Scientists are still searching for a cure for cancer.

the day or evening before a holiday or event
We always open one present on Christmas Eve.

information about reactions to a product, a person's performance of a task, etc., used as a basis for improvement
We appreciate your feedback on our new service.

a person or animal that fights
He's a real fighter and never gives up.

a tool or implement, especially one for delicate or scientific work
She plays several musical instruments.

the profession or practice of providing care for the sick and infirm
She decided to pursue a career in nursing.

a person who operates equipment or a machine
Please connect me to the operator.

the action or process of making ready or being made ready for use or consideration
The team is in full preparation for the big game.

a blow with the fist
He delivered a powerful punch to the bag.

a track or set of tracks made of steel rails along which passenger and freight trains run
The old railroad tracks are no longer in use.

the action or process of registering or being registered
Online registration for the conference is now open.

a feeling of excitement and mystery associated with love
They shared a beautiful romance.

any of the distinct types of material of which animals or plants are made, consisting of specialized cells and their products
Could you pass me a tissue, please?

a part of a film or television show that is shown in advance to advertise it
We watched the trailer for the new movie.

a public statement
The principal made an important announcement.

a film or TV program presenting facts
We watched a documentary about the history of space travel.

an act of kindness; approval or support
Could you do me a favour and help me move this box?

a place of burial for a dead body
They visited the soldier's grave.

a type of music
I love listening to jazz music.

a room or building equipped for scientific experiments, research, or teaching
Scientists conduct experiments in the laboratory.

praise
The teacher gave him praise for his hard work.

presentation
She gave a great presentation on her research.

rocket
The rocket launched into space.

symbol
The dove is a symbol of peace.

agenda
What's on the agenda for today's meeting?

bow (weapon or knot)
He tied a bow in his shoelaces.

cape (garment or landform)
The superhero wore a red cape.

cooperation
International cooperation is essential for peace.

craft (skill or small boat)
She enjoys various arts and crafts.

fortune
She told him his fortune.

hardware
We need to buy new computer hardware.

a small group of words
Can you explain the meaning of that phrase?

a marine mammal; a stamp
We saw a seal basking on the rocks.

a smooth surface for sliding
The children loved playing on the slide in the park.
